## Replace Tokens in Files

Replace parameters between tokens. The default start and end delimiters allow you to replace parameters defined following the parameter reference syntax.

- **Slug:** `replace-tokens-in-files`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 2
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| File Path | `path` | Text | No | `$(params.deploy-kubernetes-path)` |  |
| Files | `files` | Text | No | `$(params.deploy-kubernetes-file)` |  |
| Start Delimiter | `tokenStartDelimiter` | Text | No | `\$\(params\.` | Enter regex string, escaping special characters. |
| End Delimiter | `tokenEndDelimiter` | Text | No | `\)` | Enter regex string, escaping special characters. |
| Replacement Values | `allParams` | Text Area | No | `$(allParams)` | New line delimited key value pairs |
| Fail If Not Found | `failIfNotFound` | Boolean | No | `false` |  |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `files` | List of files where the token was replaced |
